assertionSteps.title: 1. Given Admin A uses subject "admin-a" with role "FMO_ADMIN" in an isolated authenticated browser
2. And the controlled Category fixture records the initial grid rows and persisted values
3. And the Category grid has record "101" owned by "FMO_ADMIN"
4. And the baseline fixture data defines "Category Label" as "case-083"
5. And the originally loaded "Category Label" value is "OLD"
6. When Admin A clicks the button labeled "Edit" in the Category grid row with "Record Id" "101"
7. Then the dialog titled "edit ID: 101" is visible on the Category administration page
8. When Admin B completes a controlled concurrent update setting "Category Label" to "NEW"
9. And Admin A fills the textbox labeled "Category Label" with "STALE" in dialog "edit ID: 101"
10. And Admin A clicks the button labeled "Update" in dialog "edit ID: 101"
11. Then the alert with severity "error" in the portal snackbar displays the agreed message for a stale-record error
